name: Blue Ghost
tagline: Firefly's first Moon landing: upright, and 14 days of surface work
description: Blue Ghost is Firefly Aerospace's lunar lander: 2 m tall and 3.5 m wide, on four legs, with one central engine of more than 1,000 N that burns MMH and MON-3, and up to 400 W of solar power. On its first mission it carried ten NASA instruments to Mare Crisium, near Mons Latreille. It touched down on 2025-03-02 within its 100 m landing target, upright and stable, and worked for more than 14 days, until lunar sunset on 2025-03-16, sending back more than 119 GB of data.
best_known_for: Firefly's first Moon landing: upright, and 14 days of surface work
